scene.ko: 도슨트 해설 중에 그림 속 인물에 대해 질문하고, 내 해석을 나누며 작품에 얽힌 이야기를 듣는다.

lines.en: This is The Quiet Window, painted by Margaret Lowe in 1921. Does anyone have any questions?
lines.ko: 이 작품은 마거릿 로가 1921년에 그린 «고요한 창»입니다. 질문 있으신 분 계신가요?

lines.en: Yes, I do. Why is the woman facing away from us? We can't see her face at all.
lines.ko: 네, 있어요. 여자는 왜 우리를 등지고 있나요? 얼굴이 전혀 안 보여요.
alt: I have a question. Why is the woman turned away? We can't see her face.
Yes. Why can't we see the woman's face?

lines.en: Good question. What do you think? There's no right or wrong answer.
lines.ko: 좋은 질문이에요. 어떻게 생각하세요? 정답은 없어요.

lines.en: Hmm, maybe she's waiting for someone. To me, it feels a little lonely.
lines.ko: 음, 누군가를 기다리는 것 같아요. 저한테는 좀 쓸쓸하게 느껴져요.
alt: Maybe she's waiting for someone. It feels a bit lonely to me.
I guess she's waiting for someone. It feels kind of lonely.

lines.en: That's a lovely way to see it. In fact, Lowe painted this the year her husband went overseas for work.
lines.ko: 멋진 해석이에요. 실제로 로는 남편이 일 때문에 해외로 떠난 해에 이 그림을 그렸어요.

lines.en: That explains a lot. Is that why the room is so dark, while the street outside is so bright?
lines.ko: 그러니 이해가 되네요. 그래서 바깥 거리는 그렇게 밝은데 방 안은 이렇게 어두운 건가요?
alt: That makes sense. Is that why the room is dark but the street is bright?

lines.en: Exactly. The contrast shows how far she feels from the busy world outside.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 그 대비가 그녀와 바쁜 바깥세상 사이의 거리감을 보여 주죠.

lines.en: I would have walked right past it without knowing that. Did she paint any others like this?
lines.ko: 그걸 몰랐으면 그냥 지나쳤을 거예요. 이런 작품을 또 그렸나요?
alt: I'd have walked right by it without knowing that. Are there other paintings like this by her?
I never would have noticed that on my own. Did she paint others like this?

lines.en: She did. Two of them are in the next room, and you'll notice the same window in both.
lines.ko: 네. 그중 두 점이 다음 전시실에 있는데, 두 작품 모두에 같은 창문이 나와요.

lines.en: I'll definitely take a closer look. Thank you for such a thoughtful explanation.
lines.ko: 꼭 자세히 볼게요. 이렇게 깊이 있게 설명해 주셔서 감사해요.
alt: I'll make sure to look closely. Thank you for the great explanation.
I'll go see them. Thanks for explaining it so well.

expressions.note: 작품의 느낌을 말할 때 (lonely · calm · warm)

expressions.en: I would have walked right past it.
Thank you for such a thoughtful explanation.
